title: DeFlow: Decoupling Behavior-Prior Modeling and Value Maximization for Offline Policy Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2601.10471v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present DeFlow, a decoupled offline RL framework that leverages flow matching to faithfully capture complex behavior manifolds. Optimizing generative policies is computationally prohibitive, typically necessitating backpropagation through ODE solvers. We address this by learning a lightweight refinement module within an explicit, data-derived trust region of the flow manifold, rather than sacrificing the iterative generation capability via single-step distillation. This way, we bypass solver differentiation and eliminate the need for balancing loss terms, ensuring stable improvement while fully preserving the flow's iterative expressivity. Empirically, DeFlow achieves superior performance on the challenging OGBench benchmark and demonstrates efficient offline-to-online adaptation.

translated_title: DeFlow：解耦行为先验建模与价值最大化的离线策略提取
translated_abstract: 我们提出了DeFlow，一个解耦的离线强化学习框架，它利用流匹配来忠实捕捉复杂的行为流形。优化生成式策略的计算代价极为高昂，通常需要对ODE求解器进行反向传播。为解决这一问题，我们在一个由数据导出的显式流形信任域内学习一个轻量级的精炼模块，而不是通过单步蒸馏牺牲迭代生成能力。这样，我们绕过了求解器微分，并消除了平衡多个损失项的需要，在确保稳定改进的同时完整保留了流的迭代表达能力。在实证方面，DeFlow在具有挑战性的OGBench基准测试中取得了卓越的性能，并展示了高效的离线到在线适应能力。
tldr: DeFlow通过解耦行为先验建模与价值最大化，在流流形的信任域内学习轻量级精炼模块，避免对ODE求解器求导，在完整保留流模型迭代表达能力的同时实现稳定的离线强化学习性能提升与高效的在线适应。
en_tdlr: DeFlow decouples behavior-prior modeling from value maximization by learning a lightweight refinement module within a data-derived trust region of the flow manifold, bypassing ODE solver differentiation while fully preserving the flow's iterative expressivity for stable offline RL improvement and efficient offline-to-online adaptation.
